g.text: Does moonrise tell corals when to spawn? If it did, the dots would climb with the line.
Instead they stay nearly flat, about 1 h 53 after sunset, on almost every night.
Spawning keeps to the Sun, whatever the Moon is doing

Dots are nudged sideways to stay visible. Rising line: median moonrise across reefs. Nearly flat line: same-reef trend through the dots. Moonlight: lit share of the Moon × its height. Data: Baird et al. (2021).
Dots: 327 exact starts, 172 spawning nights, 35 reef sites. Trend: 776 natural-reef starts, exact and approximate, each genus against itself on its own reef: +1.7 min per night (95% CI 0.5 to 3.4).

One linear fit across reefs: +3.9 (CI -0.8 to 7.5), partly as reefs keep different hours. Five start-time samples: +0.6 to +1.8 same reef, +2.2 to +4.6 mixed. Starts vary 2.7× less around sunset than moonrise.
